scope: All non-system base tables and partitions: sorted per-row SHA256 of JSON representation, then SHA256 aggregate. Counts and hashes only; no row values or credentials exported. Metadata covers columns, relation ownership/ACL/RLS, constraints, policies, triggers, routines, sequences, schemas, roles excluding password hashes, memberships and default ACLs. One repeatable-read/read-only transaction. Metadata also includes index definitions and extension owners/schemas/versions.
limitations: Not a restore rehearsal or proof of application health.
No claim of schema migration equivalence or live production certification.
Cluster role definitions are hashed, not backed up by pg_dump; canonical fresh bootstrap must reproduce required globals.
Any intentional future fixture refinements or source migration must have separately declared exact witness deltas.
